content: The UI renders a Field for 'Multi-origin blend' with a Select that conditionally appears when dualAvailable is true. When blendMode is not 'primary_only', it shows a 'Secondary panorama' Select with auto-option and candidate list, plus an amber warning if dualReady is false. If eligible.length===0, a graybox hint appears. A 'Geometry occlusion' Toggle (default true) controls whether surfaces hidden behind geometry are excluded.

evidence.excerpt:
{dualAvailable && (

            label="Multi-origin blend"
            hint="Dominant modes fill weak regions of the dominant pano using distance from each origin (not true occlusion)."
          >

items.text: UI renders a Field labeled 'Multi-origin blend' with Select only when dualAvailable is true, showing BLEND_OPTIONS map with PROJECTOR_BLEND_MODE_LABELS translation.

When settings.blendMode !== 'primary_only', the Secondary panorama Select appears with options including 'Auto (next eligible)' and secondaryCandidates map showing pano.name with isCanonical and origin positions.

items.text: Amber warning text appears when dualReady is false and blendMode !== 'primary_only', explaining 'Dual blend needs two panoramas with image assets. Import and align a second styled panorama.'
